purpose: Separate time phases of awareness so SignalTerrain never mixes historical rumor with current conditions.
note: threatContext is an educational timeline framing — not a threat-actor dossier.

phases.label: Current conditions
phases.description: What appears active or in effect now within freshness windows.
phases.consumerRule: May lead a calm digest when confidence ≥ moderate.

phases.label: Emerging conditions
phases.description: Early or incomplete signals worth watching — emphasize unknowns.
phases.consumerRule: Prefer glance/learn attention; avoid alarming headlines.

phases.label: Resolved events
phases.description: Closed outages, ended events, or archived advisories with clear end state.
phases.consumerRule: Useful for learning; do not keep in 'active' urgency.

phases.label: Historical patterns
phases.description: Comparable past periods for contrast (e.g. prior HF openings, prior vendor advisory cadence).
phases.consumerRule: Always label as pattern, not prophecy.

phases.label: Seasonal trends
phases.description: Recurring seasonality (summer thunderstorm QRN, winter HF paths, holiday phishing themes).
